hide_shy.description: The editor hides shy layers in the layer list. No effect on the picture. Default false.

markers.description: Composition markers, in ascending time. Default none.

motion_blur_adaptive_limit.description: The most sub-samples a 2D layer gets. Default 128.

motion_blur_samples.description: Samples per frame: the least number of motion-blur sub-samples, and the number for 3D layers and for shape / text content.

pixel_aspect.description: Pixel aspect ratio of the frame; 1 = square.

poster_time.description: The time of the frame the project panel shows as thumbnail. Default 0. Ticks: 254016000000 per second.

preserve_frame_rate.description: Nested in another composition, or rendered at another rate, the composition shows only its own frames: the time it is asked for is floored to its frame grid. Default false.

preserve_resolution.description: Nested in a composition rendered at reduced resolution, it still renders at full size. Default false.

renderer.description: The 3D renderer. Default `Classic3D`. `Classic3D`: 3D layers are planes, depth-sorted; `Advanced3D`: a mesh renderer with models, extrusion and image-based light.

Custom.description: Every n-th pixel in each direction.

resolution.description: The resolution the EDITOR previews at: `Auto`, `Full`, `Half`, `Third`, `Quarter`, or {"Custom": n} (every n-th pixel, 2..40). No effect on the document. Default `Auto`.

shutter_angle.description: Motion-blur shutter angle in degrees: 360 = open for a whole frame (profile document 6.6).

shutter_phase.description: Motion-blur shutter phase in degrees: where the shutter opens relative to the frame time, 360 = one frame later; negative = earlier.

work_area.description: The work area: [start, end] in ticks of composition time.

id.description: The item's id: unique in the project, never reused.

label.description: The item's label. A colour label: a display aid with no effect on the picture.

layers.description: The layers from the TOP of the stack (drawn last, in front) to the bottom (drawn first). The position in this list is the layer's index (1 = first) in the editor and in expressions.

items.description: One layer and the node that holds it.

anyOf.description: Id of the folder the item is in; null: the project's root.

parent.description: Id of the folder the item is in; null: the project's root.

anyOf.description: The item's proxy; null or absent: none.

proxy.description: The item's proxy; null or absent: none.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema. Always 1 in profile motion-comp/1; a reader refuses the node (node scope) when it is anything else.

anyOf.description: The `core.keyframe.tracks` node holding the keyframes of this payload's properties that carry `track` (the global light). Null or absent: none.

tracks.description: The `core.keyframe.tracks` node holding the keyframes of this payload's properties that carry `track` (the global light). Null or absent: none.
